title: DEF Dosing Unit Open Circuit
shortDescription: FPT NEF/Cursor engine dosing valve circuit open.
fullDescription:
Case IH Magnum, Steiger, Maxxum tractors with FPT engines (4.5L NEF, 6.7L NEF, 8.7L Cursor) use Bosch SCR. SPN 3361 FMI 5 sets when the dosing solenoid circuit is open.

Tier 4 derate ladder applies if uncorrected.

fixSteps.title: Connect EST diagnostic tool
fixSteps.instruction: CNH Electronic Service Tool to read codes and freeze frame.

fixSteps.title: Replace dosing valve
fixSteps.instruction: Drain DEF lines, unbolt valve, install new with new gasket.

fixSteps.title: Run dosing test
fixSteps.instruction: EST DEF system test verifies new valve.

faq.a: Yes, to clear inducement and run dosing test.

title: Engine Coolant Temperature High
fullDescription:
Engine derate or shutdown will follow. Common causes are plugged radiator screen with crop dust, low coolant, or failed thermostat.

FPT engines have reverse-fan capability on later models.

fixSteps.title: Cool down and clean screens
fixSteps.instruction: Compressed air through screens from inside.

faq.a: Operator station triggers cleaning cycle on later Tier 4F models.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Open Circuit
fullDescription: FPT common rail injector failure. Cylinder drops, rough idle. Replace with new injector and program trim code via EST.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector and program trim code
fixSteps.instruction: Install new injector, enter trim code in EST.

faq.a: No, fueling will be off without it.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Erratic
shortDescription: CKP sensor signal intermittent or noisy.
fullDescription: Tractor may stall, no-start, or misfire. Check sensor air gap and tone wheel for damage.

fixSteps.title: Pull and clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Magnetic debris on tip is common.

fixSteps.title: Resistance check
fixSteps.instruction: Compare to spec, replace if open.

whenToCallPro: Tone wheel damage requires front cover removal.

faq.a: Yes, intermittent CKP causes random stalling that scanners may miss.

title: Fuel Filter Restriction / Engine Protection Active
shortDescription: Engine in protect mode due to upstream fault.
fullDescription:
Case IH protection mode triggered. Common cause is plugged fuel filter, but any related fault can trigger it.

Replace fuel filter and fix root cause.

fixSteps.title: Address other faults
fixSteps.instruction: Repair root issues from EST report.

faq.a: Yes, after the underlying fault is resolved.

title: DPF Differential Pressure High
fullDescription: Case IH FPT engines monitor DPF loading. Parked regen via operator station should clear it. Failed regen indicates upstream fault or ash-loaded filter.

title: Engine Oil Pressure Low
fullDescription: Tractor will shut down to protect engine. Stop and check oil immediately. Common cause is low oil level or failed sender.

fixSteps.title: Check oil level
fixSteps.instruction: Park level, top off with Case IH-spec oil.

fixSteps.title: Mechanical pressure test
fixSteps.instruction: Tee gauge into galley test port.

videoSearchQuery: Case IH low oil pressure SPN 100

faq.a: No. Tow if pressure is truly low.

title: Lost Communication With Transmission
fullDescription:
PowerShift or CVT transmission communication dropped. Limp mode usually engages.

Inspect harness across articulation joint on Steiger.

fixSteps.title: CAN bus voltage check
fixSteps.instruction: 60 ohms across CAN H/L key off.

faq.a: Yes, articulation joint flexes wear through harnesses.

title: DEF Tank Level Low
fullDescription:
Refill with ISO 22241 DEF. Inducement ladder begins at low level - warning, then derate, then 5 percent power.

Use fresh DEF only.

title: Hydraulic System Pressure Not Responding
fullDescription:
Magnum/Steiger PFC hydraulic system. Often indicates low/contaminated oil or stuck compensator.

Check Hy-Tran level and condition first.

fixSteps.title: Replace Hy-Tran and filters
fixSteps.instruction: Drain, replace filters, refill with Case IH Hy-Tran Ultraction.

fixSteps.title: Test PFC pressures
fixSteps.instruction: EST plus gauge set on test ports.
